metric.stratum: parent x task x common J8 eligibility
metric.contrast: D=same-cross on exactly the same cases
metric.primary_scale: 100*sum(D)/2000 = sum(D)/20 percentage points of all parent-task-case slots; parents and tasks equal weight; not performance gain
metric.secondary_scale: 100*sum(D)/sum(N), descriptive eligible-case normalization, not a different primary weighting
metric.pair_counts: sum of pair-averaged counts; not number of distinct cases across four pairs
metric.support: N, event counts, overlap bounds, T_min, T_max, variable margins for every pair
metric.no_division_by_zero: empty stratum contribution zero, eligible rates undefined
sensitivity: common eligibility coverage relative to version55
J0-stratified expectation on the same common set

uncertainty.case_resampling: within parent x task x joint baseline history (J0,J8_4201,J8_4202); same sampled indices for all four endpoint policies, all four pairs and both event analyses
uncertainty.case_scope: fixed trained policies and observed joint baseline composition; excludes new training-future variance
uncertainty.interval: pointwise percentile 2.5/97.5 linear, exploratory, no confirmatory gate
uncertainty.parent_resampling: all 3125 ordered draws of five parents after within-parent aggregation; descriptive, not independent confirmation
uncertainty.paired_contrast: compute D in each replicate, never subtract independently constructed CI limits
